scope: Independent integrated-worktree Workers deployment readiness review; no publisher requests, browser runs, remote API changes, or configuration edits.
conclusion: No confirmed routing, binding or private-response cache defect found in the initial source review. A subsequent adapter review found pre-handler POST buffering; the new Worker entry bounds it (worker-body-boundary.json), pending parent final Workerd rebuild/HTTP validation. Actual activation still requires artifact, binding and plan/CPU verification.

coverage.method: Manual source inspection plus targeted pattern inventory. Current integrated production bundle was not yet produced at review; prior isolated QA artifact counts are not reused as release evidence.

findings.detail: Free allows 10ms CPU/request and 100000 Worker requests/day. Cached prerender HTML/RSC still enters middleware and NextServer because cache interception is false. Old static-company fastpath is not connected. Dynamic OG ImageResponse, query-specific salary-table generation, share pages and company widgets add work. Code and wall-time measurements cannot establish deployed CPU compliance.
findings.action: Confirm actual Workers plan and CPU evidence before broad route activation; do not treat a successful build or paid-zone plan as proof of the Workers plan.

findings.detail: Adapter build creates .open-next/cache separately. populateCache copies it into assets/cdn-cgi/_next_cache. Adapter upload/deploy performs this step; direct Wrangler upload needs a separate completed population step.
findings.action: Require final production cache count/build-id match before upload; never use the QA tree.

findings.detail: Existing zone Cache Rules and s-maxage alone do not prove a Worker-generated HTML response avoids Worker execution. No app HTML full-response cache.put wrapper was found; the selected incremental cache stores build-time data. The OG endpoint has its own bounded parameter-normalized Cache API. Worker Cache, if used, is separate operational configuration requiring RSC/query/cookie/private-path review.
findings.action: Keep /api/contact and /api/feedback uncached. Verify real cache rules do not merge HTML/RSC or query-specific responses. No new full-response cache was added.

findings.detail: public/_routes.json is a Pages control file with no Workers routing authority. OpenNext copies public recursively; Wrangler ignores _headers/_redirects/.assetsignore by default, but not _routes.json. Without .assetsignore this benign 746-byte routing JSON can become an ordinary public asset. No public/_redirects file exists.
findings.action: Optionally retain the Pages original but add /_routes.json to public/.assetsignore. No config was changed by this reviewer.

verifiedSourceContracts.result: run_worker_first false permits exact public/immutable assets to bypass Worker. html_handling none and not_found_handling none avoid static HTML canonicalization or SPA fallback. Application HTML is stored in reserved cdn-cgi cache containers rather than public route files, so intended HTML/RSC/API requests use middleware and NextServer. Final output collision check remains required.

_headers applies to static assets only. Worker security headers remain in next.config and private/widget route handlers. English 404 and guide-search variants retain private/no-store and robots decisions in middleware. Middleware canonical-host and salary redirects, plus Next config redirects, remain active. _redirects is absent, so there is no legacy platform redirect conflict.

Legacy entry imports removed next-on-pages and .vercel manifest, but package cf:build and wrangler main use OpenNext. The legacy source is retained for historical/rollback context and is not an active Worker entry. Its previous optimized response path is not migrated.

Read-only, build-ID namespaced, no ISR or composable-cache support. No application revalidation export/use was found in the targeted source scan. Private POST routes are force-dynamic and are not build cache inputs. A new deployed build replaces the prerender snapshot; data edits require build/release.

Cloudflare bindings are read from request-scoped getCloudflareContext; no process.env DB fallback. Missing/malformed D1 or inadequate secret fails closed. Exact HTTPS configured origin plus request URL and Origin must match; request data cannot set this binding. Input bodies are bounded; SQL is parameterized and batched; private/no-store/noindex responses do not expose storage details. The existing FEEDBACK_DB and FEEDBACK_RATE_LIMIT_SECRET must be attached to the Worker independently of Pages.

OpenNext compiles project .env files into server-only cloudflare/next-env.mjs. Do not include unrelated local secrets in release checkout. No secret file was read. QA wrapper omits .env files and removes production binding/config values. Public ad identifiers must come from the approved production build inputs; NEXT_PUBLIC_ADS_DISABLED and QA flags must be absent for ordinary visitor release.

Seven invariant widgets force-static; company widget remains force-dynamic for id. Handler CSP permits framing but external scripts/connections remain denied. Service worker caches only same-origin immutable chunks plus manifest/favicon and does not cache HTML/API/RSC; it does not block normal external ads.

Retaining Pages custom domains and proxied DNS can preserve a rollback destination after removing or disabling the two new Worker routes. The reviewed Worker does not automatically proxy exceptions/404s back to Pages. Preserve prior routes/version and inspect cache/chunk compatibility during cutover and rollback; database binding reuse is not a destructive schema migration.

remainingReleaseChecks: Final production asset inventory: cache populated; build IDs match; each asset <=25MiB; file count within plan; application paths do not collide with public assets; private API does not appear in cache.

Final isolated QA local HTTP: CSP/security headers, HTML versus RSC Vary/content type, English/private 404, query-specific API, widget CSP, robots/sitemap/RSS and redirects. Parent owns running the established harness.
Actual Worker plan, 10ms CPU risk/metrics, request quota; no live publisher browser tests.
Existing D1 schema and secret binding presence, exact allowed origin, trusted Cloudflare IP path; synthetic private acceptance must not log values.
Actual proxied route ownership, exact intended Worker deployment/version/tag, retained Pages domain/DNS and rollback procedure.
Zone cache/redirect/script-injection integration behavior remains remotely unverified by this reviewer; do not infer compatibility solely from local source.

testFix.purpose: Await the actual async MonthlyPage with Promise params before SSR; preserve all four original FAQ assertions. Replace two ambiguous dynamic import strings with explicit loader maps.
testFix.result: 3 test files, 21 tests passed; no warnings; no runtime/config changes.

sources.supports: Workers Free CPU/request/day, asset-size and asset-count limits; retrieved 2026-10-17.
